properties.name: Nairobi National Park
properties.description: Kenya's first national park, home to lions, leopards, cheetahs, hyenas, buffaloes, and over 400 bird species.

properties.name: Jomo Kenyatta International Airport
properties.description: The main international airport serving Nairobi and the largest in East Africa.

properties.name: University of Nairobi
properties.description: The oldest and largest university in Kenya, founded in 1956.

properties.name: Nairobi Railway Station
properties.description: Historic railway station built in 1899, terminus of the Uganda Railway.

properties.name: Kenyatta National Hospital
properties.description: Kenya's largest referral hospital and a teaching hospital for the University of Nairobi.

properties.name: Karura Forest
properties.description: Urban forest reserve covering 1,041 hectares with hiking and cycling trails.
